description: The redirect chain of a URL, hop by hop (at most 10 hops): each URL, its status, the Location it points to, and whether the hop goes from http to https or changes host. Returns the final URL and status, total hops, loop true when a URL repeats, and the Strict-Transport-Security header of the final response. Price: $0.001 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
